paragraphs.text: The Storm Coast is the western coast of Jamuura on the plane Dominaria .
The Storm Coast takes its name from the fact that is battered by storms six months out of nine. It runs from the Buleusi Bay in the north to the Craggy Coast in the south.

In the northern part of the coast, south of Femeref and the Jaema Sea , lies Buzzard's Bay . Here can be found the ruined Amrou Haven , original home of the plane's kithkin . The southern branch of Buzzard's Bay is known as the Witch's Weir , where lie the Seafarer's Quay , the Adventurers' Guildhouse , and the keep of Fulmart's Fort , from where one can follow the river that flows into the sea back into the depths of the Arborian forest to reach Shauku 's residence. The southern shore of the weir is known as the Goat's Walk , where there are few landing points due to the cliffs and no sandy beaches. Cape Hope is the western cape of Buzzard's Bay and is home to the city of Garaboss . At the southwestern cape, the Storm Coast ends where it meets the Craggy Coast.
